name: whole-flow-end-to-end
title: A user's whole flow, end to end, with the harness mounted and a mode in force
description: Make it possible to simulate a real user's whole flow on a real project: the harness mounted, a work mode actually in force, the agent given the harness's own tools, and the work graded by the project's own suite. Two measured defects stand in the way today.
